race.comment: Tricky mare's race to finish. Not sure what to do with CONCORD CONNIE (12), who was beaten in a BM78 at Mornington first up at $1.30. She'd looked a star last preparation but it was in 3yo company and the draw here certainly isn't ideal. Respecting her upside but sub $2.50 in early betting is enough to look elsewhere. SHADHAVAR (4) has been solid her past two since a good win over Persian Spirit here. Up to 1400m is okay without being a positive. WROTE TO ARATAKI (2) was too bad to be true on the heavy at Flemington when five weeks between runs. She's getting on but at a huge price as a previous winner of this race. BUTTERNUT PRINCESS (11) has had no luck in her past two, can see the map looking sticky again though.
